title: BEST INFINITE MOB FARM 1.21! Minecraft Tutorial In 60s!
description: In this tutorial, I will show you how to make the next generation of mob farming in Minecraft. This farm uses a new pattern, making it possible to stack 4 layers in one, reaching almost 4x power, a simple module that was not possible before. extremely fast and compact, and it's also cheap, just using one dispenser in Minecraft!
